title: Kevin Casiel - so damn protected
htmlContent:
Kevin Casiel's "so damn protected" is a supreme level record that puts the entire culture on notice. He’s a sure fire star and it couldn’t be any more apparent than hearing his music. He excels in every aspect of his craft to make something that any one who presses play will love for every second.

Each line stops you in you tracks as he talks his talk, like no other firing off mazing wordplay, with an impeccable flow that is second to none. This all happens over a production he crafted himself to show his full range of talent in the best way possible.
